'''Verig''' was a primitive [[Planet/Legends|planet]] home to a group of [[Unidentified Verig species|native nomadic hunters]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] tactician [[Beryl Chiffonage]] traveled to Verig and drew inspiration from the planet's nomads, who used a [[Bola/Legends|bola]]-like weapon to trip the large [[Pryss-creature]]s, to develop a similar [[Rogue Doctrine|maneuver]] for use against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].
